name: Wealthfolio
one_liner: An open-source portfolio tracker that keeps investments, net worth and spending entirely on your device — no cloud account.

text.why: Most portfolio trackers require handing account data to a cloud server. Wealthfolio is a desktop and mobile app that keeps everything on-device instead. Import trading activity across accounts and asset classes from CSV, and it computes time- and money-weighted returns, allocation and risk breakdowns, and dividend income over time. Automatic brokerage syncing (30+ institutions, read-only) and encrypted multi-device sync are an optional paid add-on called Wealthfolio Connect, but manual tracking and CSV import stay free forever.
text.take: It's an honest split: the one part with a real ongoing cost — brokerage sync — is the paid layer, while the core tracking stays free forever with no account.
build: Pull scattered brokerage CSVs into one view of net worth and returns
Track dividend and interest income over time to plan cash flow
Build a custom page or feature with the TypeScript addon SDK

who.role: Anyone with investments spread across several brokerages, wanting one net-worth view
Someone who doesn't want investment data sitting in someone else's cloud
A developer who wants to build a custom addon page
